title: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University researchers found a way to use discarded corn hu

metadata.reference_highlights:
Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University researchers found a way to use discarded corn husks and stalks to make cheap hydrogen fuel .
Used efficient method to convert 100% of plant sugars into 'green' fuel .
It's previously only been possible to convert 60% of sugars into hydrogen .
Breakthrough could see motorists filling up at roadside bioreactors .
